registers._note: Each dimension is the mean genome relevance of its tags. A register is a rule over dimensions.
registers._family_note: Family animation is its own mode, not a shade of adult comedy. It was missed entirely in the first build: 56 per cent of the 456 unregistered comedies were Family films and 32 per cent Animation, against 18 and 8 per cent of the registered ones. Their profiles are flat on every adult dimension (Sing 2 peaks at 0.37, Abominable at 0.22) while scoring animation 0.82, cartoon 0.72, talking animals 0.60. The darkness contrast is what does the operator's original Paw Patrol against Sausage Party test: family alone scores Sausage Party 0.38 and The Super Mario Bros. Movie 0.35, nearly identical, and dark separates them at 0.35 against 0.15. The 0.50 shortcut exists so Shrek, family 0.86 but dark 0.39 from its own snark, is not lost.
